method_note: Prospective subjective probabilities from the supplied packet and general reasoning only; no inference, model outputs, historical results, or other sources were consulted. Half-reference interventions are treated as uncertain and incomplete semantic biases. Canonical descriptions inform the direction but conflicting vocabulary projections temper confidence and add alternate plausible effects; opposite signs need not invert a persona. Identity prompts preferentially expose self-role, social replies allow more affection and sustained style, and strict task/fiction attribution suppresses assistant persona positives. Pair effects are partially additive with extra disruption uncertainty. Joint rates allow correlated feline/female adoption and are separately constrained by their marginals and coherence; they are not independence products.
